::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/countries/{code}"}
#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | `string` | **yes** | ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, case-insensitive |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `country`. One of `country`. |
| `code` | `string` | The country's ISO-3166 alpha-2 code. |
| `name` | `string` | The country's name. |
| `dial_code` | `string` | Identifies a numbering PLAN, not a country — +1 is the whole NANP. |
| `phone_pattern` | `string` | Pattern for the national number (no dial code, no trunk 0). Anchor it as ^(?:…)$; null means there is no format to check. |
| `phone_lengths` | `array of integer` | Allowed national-number lengths in digits; null means any. |
| `region_label` | `string` | Local name for the region field — "State", "Province", "Prefecture". |
| `postal_label` | `string` | Local name for the postal field. |
| `has_postal_code` | `boolean` | False for the ~60 countries with no postal system — hide the field entirely. |
| `postal_regex` | `string` | Anchor it as ^(?:…)$; null means there is no format to check. |
| `postal_redundant` | `string` | Characters to strip before matching (usually " -"). |
| `postal_hint` | `string` | An example postal code for the country. |
| `subdivision_strict` | `boolean` | True when a non-empty subdivision outside the list is rejected. |
| `has_subdivisions` | `boolean` | Whether a list exists at all — some territories have none. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such country |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/countries/US"
```

    10
  ],
  "region_label": "State",
  "postal_label": "PIN code",
  "has_postal_code": false,

}
